job.theme: a cricket match between two schools

response.passage: The annual cricket match between Green Valley School and St. Jude’s Academy took place on 15th March at the City Stadium. The weather was perfect, but the pitch was unusually dry and dusty. Because the pitch was so dry, the ball spun sharply, making it very difficult for the batsmen to score runs. Rohan, the captain of Green Valley, decided to bowl his spinners early in the game. This strategy worked well as St. Jude’s lost four wickets in the first ten overs. However, the game changed when Rahul, the star batsman for St. Jude’s, entered the field. He played carefully and hit the ball along the ground to avoid the spin. By the end of the match, St. Jude’s reached a total of 120 runs. Green Valley chased the target easily, winning the match by five wickets. The crowd cheered loudly for both teams, celebrating the spirit of the game. The principal of Green Valley, Mrs. Sharma, praised the players for their discipline. Everyone agreed that the dry pitch was the main reason for the low scoring rate in the first half of the match.
response.summary: Green Valley School played a cricket match against St. Jude’s Academy at the City Stadium. The dry pitch made batting difficult, but Green Valley eventually won the game by five wickets.
